focus_areas.gate_placement: CORRECT. The gate is inserted immediately after `opt_rules = profit_rules` (profit amplifier reassignment) and after `opt_score = _score_metrics(...)`, but before the Phase 5 validation gates (val_ret/pf/symbol-concentration/tail-holdout). This matches the spec preference: 'apply the gate on the final selected rules (after risk opt and profit amp)'.
focus_areas.edge_cases: Handled. Uses getattr with defaults (RB_REQUIRE_SYMBOL_FILTERS=False, RB_MIN_DISTINCT_SYMBOLS=0) so missing config attrs are safe. _symbols_in_rules uses rule.get('conditions', []) so missing keys are safe. min_distinct==0 short-circuits via `if min_distinct > 0`. Empty opt_rules (e.g. profit amp emptied it) yields n_symbols=0 < min -> fails closed safely (reason is technically 'insufficient_distinct_symbols' which may mask a profit-amp-empty cause, but fail-closed behavior is correct and defensive).
focus_areas.tests: 12 new tests, all pass. Cover all 3 required cases (filters-on+1sym+min5 -> fail closed; filters-on+enough -> not rejected by this gate; filters-off -> skipped) plus _symbols_in_rules helper unit tests, min=0 skip, exact-meet (5 sym, min=5), and Output_Writer.load_and_validate loadability of the empty fail-closed strategy. Tests mock the surrounding pipeline (_compose_ruleset/_optimize_risk/_run_profit_amplifier/CPUBacktestEngine/etc.) but exercise the REAL gate code path (gate itself is not mocked), so the assertion is meaningful.
focus_areas.regressions: None. Existing rb_governor tests (test_rb_governor_cv_folds, test_rb_governor_data_load, test_rb_governor_tail_holdout = 26 tests) and test_rb_fail_closed (17 tests) all pass. The new gate only triggers when RB_REQUIRE_SYMBOL_FILTERS=True AND RB_MIN_DISTINCT_SYMBOLS>0 AND n_symbols<min; default/off path is unchanged.

findings.description: Report uses key `fail_closed_reason` while the sibling task-1 fail-closed report (line 1476) uses `reason`. No downstream code consumes these report keys (writer.py only reads the strategy JSON's deployment_accepted), so this is cosmetic, but inconsistent for human/dash readers.

Spec says 'Include n_symbols and required in extra/report'. Strategy extra correctly uses `required` (matching spec), but the report uses `required_symbols` instead of `required`. Minor; both are descriptive.
No test for the edge case where _run_profit_amplifier returns empty profit_rules (n_symbols=0). Behavior is safe (fails closed) but untested. Optional.

summary: Solid, minimal, correct implementation. Gate placement is exactly where the spec wants it (after profit amp, on final opt_rules). Fail-closed path mirrors the established task-1 pattern (empty rules_set, deployment_accepted=False, write strategy + report, set results[direction], continue). Tests are well-scoped: they mock the pipeline but run the real gate. No regressions. Only low-priority cosmetic naming notes; none block merge.
